verses.pali: Saṁyutta Nikāya 35.43–51
5. Sabbaaniccavagga
Aniccādisuttanavaka
Sāvatthinidānaṁ.
Tatra kho …pe…
“sabbaṁ, bhikkhave, aniccaṁ.
Kiñca, bhikkhave, sabbaṁ aniccaṁ?
verses.english: And what is the all that is impermanent?

verses.pali: Cakkhu, bhikkhave, aniccaṁ, rūpā aniccā, cakkhuviññāṇaṁ aniccaṁ, cakkhusamphasso anicco.
verses.english: The eye, sights, eye consciousness, and eye contact are impermanent.

verses.pali: Yampidaṁ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṁ sukhaṁ vā dukkhaṁ vā adukkhamasukhaṁ vā tampi aniccaṁ …pe…
verses.english: And the pleasant, painful, or neutral feeling that arises dependent on eye contact is also impermanent.

verses.pali: jivhā aniccā, rasā aniccā, jivhāviññāṇaṁ aniccaṁ, jivhāsamphasso anicco.
Yampidaṁ jivhāsamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṁ sukhaṁ vā dukkhaṁ vā adukkhamasukhaṁ vā tampi aniccaṁ.
Kāyo anicco …pe…
mano anicco, dhammā aniccā, manoviññāṇaṁ aniccaṁ, manosamphasso anicco.
verses.english: The mind, ideas, mind consciousness, and mind contact are impermanent.

verses.pali: Yampidaṁ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṁ sukhaṁ vā dukkhaṁ vā adukkhamasukhaṁ vā tampi aniccaṁ.
verses.english: The painful, pleasant, or neutral feeling that arises dependent on mind contact is also impermanent.

verses.pali: Evaṁ passaṁ, bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako cakkhusmimpi nibbindati, rūpesupi nibbindati, cakkhuviññāṇepi nibbindati, cakkhusamphassepi nibbindati.
verses.english: Seeing this, a learned noble disciple grows disillusioned …

verses.pali: Yampidaṁ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṁ sukhaṁ vā dukkhaṁ vā adukkhamasukhaṁ vā tasmimpi nibbindati …pe…
manasmimpi nibbindati, dhammesupi nibbindati, manoviññāṇepi nibbindati, manosamphassepi nibbindati,
yampidaṁ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṁ sukhaṁ vā dukkhaṁ vā adukkhamasukhaṁ vā tasmimpi nibbindati.
Nibbindaṁ virajjati; virāgā vimuccati; vimuttasmiṁ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṁ hoti.
‘Khīṇā jāti, vusitaṁ brahmacariyaṁ, kataṁ karaṇīyaṁ, nāparaṁ itthattāyā’ti pajānātī”ti.
verses.english: They understand: ‘Rebirth is ended, the spiritual journey has been completed, what had to be done has been done, there is nothing further for this place.’”

verses.pali: Paṭhamaṁ.
